title: The words of Shelley’s fragment upon the moon wandering companionless, pale for weariness.
html_source: The speakers tone in the poem is probably the way Stephen feels about himself in society.

anchor.text: the words of Shelley's fragment upon the moon wandering companionless, pale for weariness.
anchor.prefix: ore his weary mind outward to its verge and inward to its centre, a distant music accompanying him outward and inward. What music? The music came nearer and he recalled the words,
anchor.suffix:
The stars began to crumble and a cloud of fine stardust fell through space.

 The dull light fell more faintly upon the page whereon another equation began to unfold itself slowly
